purpose: Held-out independent acceptance expectations recorded before enhanced interface execution
scope: Development skill-validator enhancement supporting helpers, not full skill or protected framework acceptance

cases.input: Valid minimal package with name matching original directory and nonempty description
cases.expected: Every format entrypoint accepts required metadata; no mandatory metadata FAIL.

cases.input: All standard optional fields including compatibility and allowed-tools string; metadata string key/value pairs
cases.expected: Agent Skills format passes; creator compatibility limitations never become universal format failure.

cases.input: metadata: { version: 1 }
cases.expected: Every standards check rejects non-string metadata value, despite YAML being parseable.

cases.input: allowed-tools YAML sequence instead of required string
cases.expected: Standards FAIL in both format consumers; any host exception is explicit and separate.

cases.input: Non-string YAML key and duplicate name key; separate malformed inputs
cases.expected: Structured failure diagnostics without traceback or uncaught sorting/hash/type error.

cases.input: Name 64/65 characters, description 1024/1025 characters, compatibility 500/501 characters
cases.expected: Each permitted boundary passes; each immediately over-boundary input fails consistently.

cases.input: Valid skill copied into source directory with bound original identity then altered identity binding
cases.expected: Valid bound snapshot is accepted, mismatch rejected; snapshot directory source is not treated as original identity.

cases.input: Well-formed skill above recommended entrypoint length, legitimate Unicode prose and quoted unfinished-placeholder example
cases.expected: Length only advisory; Unicode/example observations do not become automatic mandatory behavior defect.

cases.input: Case attempt with no saved matching plan, or saved plan changed after receipt
cases.expected: Reject execution before launch or reject retrospective evidence qualification; preserve already existing evidence.

cases.input: Duplicate attempt identity and missing case inventory entry
cases.expected: Reject duplicate evidence and mark omitted requirement incomplete; no inflated pass denominator.

cases.input: Actor exits zero and announces completion but required report file is absent
cases.expected: Actual delivery obligation does not pass; stdout claim alone earns no artifact credit.

cases.input: Actor delivers expected JSON file containing wrong total despite valid syntax
cases.expected: Content oracle rejects semantically wrong output, independent of exit success.

cases.input: Actor delivers required JSON with independently computed correct total at bound path
cases.expected: Delivered file readback and correct content qualify; digest recorded.

cases.input: Whole-session plan without timeout override and utility plan without timeout override
cases.expected: Saved selected native limit is 600 seconds and utility limit 120 seconds; explicit shorter override is retained.

cases.input: Synthetic command prints marker then sleeps beyond short explicit timeout
cases.expected: Timeout retains printed marker and partial outputs, no automatic retry, cleanup result recorded.

cases.input: Blocked case with dependent plus unrelated ready case
cases.expected: Dependent remains blocked; unrelated ready case executes; campaign is incomplete without disguising the gap.

cases.input: Second attempt after retained timeout, then changed fixture/candidate bytes
cases.expected: New attempt never overwrites old evidence; drift prevents blind resume or reuse of old qualification.

cases.input: Input prompt includes literal PowerShell metacharacters and paths with spaces
cases.expected: Prompt arrives unchanged via stdin/argument array, with no interpolation or shell effects.

cases.input: Declared CLI entrypoint given invalid/missing argument and closed stdin
cases.expected: Observed exit/diagnostic matches declared interface; absence of help promise does not invent mandatory --help support.

cases.input: Fresh actor gets realistic file-processing request, skill path, raw input, output destination only
cases.expected: Artifacts meet independent outcome oracle; actor is not shown suspected bug, intended answer or proposed fix. Native activation separately unqualified unless actually observed.

limitations: Native actor trials not launched during preparation
Exact interface fixtures will be bound before execution once interface exists
Assertions are independent expectations rather than claims about implementation
